overall_reason: The showcase page wraps names and links at every width and reads with scripts off, but its byline prints a separator for an empty author and a dead share library throws on load.

score.reason: T-WIDTHS and T-NO-SCRIPT pass; T-HOSTILE-CONTENT fails on the empty byline name (ROB-019) and a script error on load fails ROB-015.

findings.title: Counts and lists survive their extremes
findings.where: Project byline under the h1 ('by , Jan Diehm, Amber Thomas (The Pudding)'), 1280 and 375px, tiles/1280-00.png and tiles/375-00.png
findings.evidence: The byline reads 'by , Jan Diehm, Amber Thomas (The Pudding)' at both widths: the template prints the comma separator for an empty first author. The Credits row below names 'Alvin Chang, Journalist-Engineer, The Pudding', so the first author record exists elsewhere and is blank in the byline.
findings.before: The author list joins every entry with commas, including an empty one.
findings.after: Join only non-empty names, and fall back to the credit name when the author field is blank.
findings.why: The first line under the title looks broken and drops the lead author's name.

findings.title: Content and navigation do not depend on script
findings.evidence: resilience.console_errors: 4, including 'addthis is not defined', net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED, a 404 and a connection reset. Text still reads with scripts off (974 of 1085 characters, 87%).
findings.before: The page calls a share library that no longer loads.
findings.after: Remove the AddThis calls or guard them, and drop the dead library request.
findings.why: Each showcase page throws an error on load, and the share buttons do nothing.

findings.title: Room for other languages
findings.where: Header nav (About, News, Awards, FAQs, Entry Showcase, Nominations, Sponsor), 1280 and 1440px, tiles/1280-00.png
findings.evidence: rows_without_room_for_35pct: seven links in a 557px row with free_px 30 against needed_for_35pct_px 132.
findings.before: The header row is almost as wide as its seven English labels.
findings.after: Move the nav into the menu at a width where the row runs out of room, not only at the phone breakpoint.
findings.why: The site is English-only, so this is a readiness note: one more section will not fit.

strengths: At 375 the credit rows wrap long names and award titles ('Alvin Chang, Journalist-Engineer, The Pudding', 'Information is Beautiful Awards 2024') inside their cells (tiles/375-00.png).
The vote panel and related projects move below the article on phones (tiles/375-01.png); nothing is lost.
The page reads with scripts off at the same share as the baseline (87%) and the document matches every viewport width.
